_notes.appId: PLACEHOLDER. The release application ID is OPEN per ADR-0006 and must be chosen with the owner before any Play submission. check-packaging.py rejects any appId without a placeholder/example marker.
_notes.webDir: Relative local build output of the shared responsive web source. A remote https URL here is rejected: the Android app must be built from the same source, not pointed at the deployed website.
_notes.server: No remote url is configured. The packaged app talks to the authenticated public API ingress (E17) through normal HTTPS requests, never to tailnet-only or loopback addresses.
